description: Aerodrome reference points (ARP) for every departure and destination in the 30-OFP private corpus. Published AIP AD 2.2 values, rounded to 1e-5 degree. Independent of the OFP parser; tests/test_route_map_anchors_20261013.py cross-checks each value against the coordinate the OFP itself prints on the destination row (agreement within 1 NM).
